text: The New Zealand Volcano Science Advisory Panel (NZVSAP) is a national advisory mechanism established to provide coordinated volcanic science advice during volcanic unrest and eruptions in New Zealand. Hosted by the National Emergency Management Agency (NEMA), it integrates multi-institutional expertise to deliver real-time monitoring and scientific assessments to decision-makers, stakeholders, and the public. The panel is embedded within New Zealand's emergency management system and collaborates with GeoNet for data and monitoring.
